limitations.message: Timing lines land further apart than the 5 m corner gate: no corner-level metre claims.
The location feed reports every car on one shared line: there is no lateral or racing-line information.
Positions at a time lie between two real samples of the same driver (bracket given); nothing is extrapolated.
Metres are the lap fraction from the measured finish line times the cited lap length, not surveyed distance.
Built from the session recording; a running live session is not spatialized.
